facts.fact: The article reports the Access to Information Act, Cap 95 (ATIA), as the law giving a right of access under its section 4, applied by the High Court in a judgment of 7 August 2026; the article gives no year of enactment, so the judgment date is used.
facts.system: The Access to Information Act, Cap 95

facts.fact: The High Court of Uganda (Civil Division) on 7 August 2026 allowed UNEB's appeal against a Chief Magistrates Court order, made on a complaint against an information officer's decision under the ATIA, that had compelled release of a candidate's examination scripts, and set aside UGX 12,000,000 damages.
facts.system: The Access to Information Act, Cap 95

systems.system: Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap 97

facts.fact: The Constitutional Court on 4 December 2025 (Petition No. 13 of 2020) held section 1(2)(b) of the ATIA, the exemption for court records before a case concludes, unconstitutional, treating the Act as law in force.
facts.system: The Access to Information Act, Cap 95

note: Ruling is a constitutional challenge to a provision, not a decision on a request made under the law, so no reach fact.

facts.fact: This document is the text of the Access to Information Act, 2005, assented to on 7 July 2005 and commencing on a day the Minister appoints by statutory instrument; it gives every citizen a right of access to records of public bodies.

facts.fact: AFIC's May 2024 presentation says Uganda's Access to Information Act (2005) elaborates how the constitutional right of access to information held by public bodies is exercised.
AFIC's May 2024 presentation says the Access to Information Act (2005) has Regulations (2011) that specify the information citizens can request and the exemptions.
